chapter.nerocreatures.bestiary.title: Bestiary
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.pale_hunter: Lunar Stalkers hunt the dark plains of the moon. Bring down four and keep a little sinew as proof of the first entry in your bestiary.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.crystal_cla: A Crystal Golem is the crystalline worlds made to walk. Break one and record the refined crystal it leaves behind.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.jelly_logic: Plasma Slimes split, merge and somehow keep their charge. Study six of them and note the plasma cells they carry.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.first_conta: Something crawls out of the dark between worlds. Meet a Void Crawler and log a sample of the essence it is made of.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.scrap_right: Rogue Drones still patrol for owners long gone. Ground three and salvage the circuitry they leave behind.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.shield_brea: A Rogue Android hides behind its shield until it does not. Take one down and recover the core that kept it running.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.second_hand: Circuitry, plasma and an android core: put what the machines left behind to better use and assemble a drone shell of your own.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.boarding_pa: Space Pirates raid wherever there is something worth taking. Repel five of them and note what they were carrying.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.ember_crown: The Cinder Tyrant rules the ash of Cindara, and appears only rarely. Survive its phases, end the fight and keep the trophy.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.cindara_qui: A world record: the first time a Cinder Tyrant is defeated on Cindara, the ember world goes quiet for everyone on this server.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.field_guide: Golems, machines, pirates and a tyrant: your bestiary covers the creatures of Nerospace. A record of everything you have met out there.
Not everything out here wants you dead. Earn the trust of a Glacite Wisp or a Xertz Forager and tame your first companion.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.drone_deplo: A drone shell is only a shell until someone switches it on. Deploy your Terraforming Drone and give it a patch of ground to work.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.scrapyard.d: Drones, androids: the machines keep coming. Scrap ten mechanical foes of any kind and leave a scrapyard where they stood.

gui.nerocreatures.bestiary.traits.intro: Tameable creatures, mounts and livestock each carry two traits. Offspring take one trait from each parent; each inherited trait has a %s%% chance to mutate into a new one.
gui.nerocreatures.bestiary.traits.intro_: Tameable creatures, mounts and livestock each carry two traits. Offspring take one trait from each parent.
gui.nerocreatures.bestiary.traits.radian: About 1 in 100 per trait on a wild creature. Two Radiant parents almost always have Radiant young.
gui.nerocreatures.bestiary.trait.calm: Panics half as long. Never bucks a rider.
gui.nerocreatures.bestiary.trait.stout: Mount panniers hold %s slots, not 9. Cosmetic on other creatures.
gui.nerocreatures.bestiary.trait.radiant: Rare pearl colour morph. Cosmetic only.
bestiary.nerocreatures.lunar_stalker.abi: Hunts in packs: the first to spot you calls idle stalkers within 16 blocks, and each flanks to its own side. Bolder and faster at night.
bestiary.nerocreatures.lunar_stalker.wea: Fight in a corridor or break line of sight: the flank is what kills. Packs lose their edge when they cannot spread out.
bestiary.nerocreatures.lumen_moth.abilit: A living lantern: a tamed moth lights the air around its owner and reveals hidden, burrowed and dormant creatures nearby. Wild moths gather at light.
bestiary.nerocreatures.lumen_moth.weakne: Fragile and drawn to light: Echo Shrikes hunt moths, so keep yours close in Luna's dark.
bestiary.nerocreatures.echo_shrike.abili: Blind: it hunts by sound. Sprinting, mining and landing draw it, and it lunges when it hears you close.
bestiary.nerocreatures.echo_shrike.weakn: A sneaking player is invisible to it. Move quietly, then strike first.
bestiary.nerocreatures.lode_tortoise.abi: Grows ore nodules on its shell from the ore it grazes near. Mine them off with a pickaxe without harming it; they regrow.
bestiary.nerocreatures.lode_tortoise.wea: Slow and harmless: it never fights back. Its only threat is to your patience while the nodules regrow.
bestiary.nerocreatures.dune_loper.abilit: A saddled mount with a low-gravity bounding leap on the jump bar, paid for in stamina, and panniers for cargo.
bestiary.nerocreatures.dune_loper.weakne: Its leap drains stamina: let it recover between bounds or it cannot jump at all.
bestiary.nerocreatures.strata_hound.abil: Show it an ore, raw ore or natural stone: it tracks the nearest match within 24 blocks, leads you there and marks it.
bestiary.nerocreatures.strata_hound.weak: It only follows what you show it, and only blocks within its range. It never digs or fights for ore.
bestiary.nerocreatures.dust_devil.abilit: A whirlwind that lifts and throws players and dropped items and cuts visibility. It cannot be hit while it spins up.
bestiary.nerocreatures.dust_devil.weakne: Wait out the spin-up, then strike when the column opens. Stay low and away from ledges while it throws.
bestiary.nerocreatures.slag_beetle.abili: A living furnace: eats raw ore its owner throws to it and, after digesting, drops the smelted result with a 10% bonus chance.
bestiary.nerocreatures.slag_beetle.weakn: It takes raw ore items only, and only ones its owner threw. Ore blocks and other players' items are ignored.
bestiary.nerocreatures.magma_wader.abili: Wades through lava and, after a clear wind-up, lobs cooling slag that hardens into temporary crust.
bestiary.nerocreatures.magma_wader.weakn: The lob has a long wind-up: step aside, then close in. Out of lava it is slow to turn.
bestiary.nerocreatures.cinder_tyrant.abi: Three phases: slam shockwaves, then fireball volleys and Plasma Slime adds, then an enraged Meltdown. Immune to fire and lava.
bestiary.nerocreatures.cinder_tyrant.wea: Walk out of the telegraphed slam ring, use cover against volleys, and leave adds alive: killing them lets it call more.
bestiary.nerocreatures.glacite_wisp.abil: A drifting knot of ice that never starts a fight. Tamed, it follows and defends you and lends Slow Falling while you fall nearby.
bestiary.nerocreatures.glacite_wisp.weak: Harmless and slow to react: it only fights back when attacked, and barely hurts.
bestiary.nerocreatures.rime_yak.ability: A cold aura puts out fires, cools players, slows hostile mobs and freezes still water slowly. Shear it for Rime Wool, milk it for Coolant Milk.
bestiary.nerocreatures.rime_yak.weakness: Its aura chills but never hurts. A yak with no wool or on milk cooldown has nothing to give until it recovers.
bestiary.nerocreatures.frost_lurker.abil: Lies buried in snow or ice and erupts when you step within 1.5 blocks, with a freezing bite after a short telegraph.
bestiary.nerocreatures.frost_lurker.weak: Leather armour keeps the frost off. Step back during the 12-tick telegraph and the bite misses.
bestiary.nerocreatures.rime_matriarch.ab: Freezes the arena floor in widening rings and fires a locked blizzard beam. Ice pillars rise around her as the only cover.
bestiary.nerocreatures.rime_matriarch.we: Get a solid block between you and her before the beam locks. Keep out of the freezing ring in the last phase.
bestiary.nerocreatures.xertz_forager.abi: A busy grazer that never attacks. Tamed, its crest glows in the dark and lends its owner Night Vision.
bestiary.nerocreatures.xertz_forager.wea: Has no attack of its own: it only defends itself weakly when hit.
bestiary.nerocreatures.spore_drifter.abi: Floats over crops and gives one crop below an extra growth tick every 4 seconds. Bottle its spores for a double bone meal.
bestiary.nerocreatures.spore_drifter.wea: Bottling empties it for 5 minutes, and tamed drifters can only be bottled by their owner.
bestiary.nerocreatures.bloom_host.abilit: Animals it kills rise as short-lived sporelings that fight for it, at most 3 each and capped per world.
bestiary.nerocreatures.bloom_host.weakne: Kill it before it reaches the herd: with no fresh kills it has no sporelings, and sporelings vanish in 30 seconds.
bestiary.nerocreatures.mossback.ability: A herd grazer that fertilises the grass it eats and flees predators together with its herd.
bestiary.nerocreatures.mossback.weakness: Prey for stalkers and lurkers: keep a herd fenced near light if you want to keep it.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drift_leviathan.a: An enormous, peaceful sky giant with a walkable back. It holds still while a player is aboard; its barnacles regrow over a day.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drift_leviathan.w: Peaceful and slow: barnacles can only be sheared when fully grown.
bestiary.nerocreatures.bloom_sovereign.a: Rooted in place, she heals from the spore pods around her, lashes and infects at range, and only takes damage from attackers she can see.
bestiary.nerocreatures.bloom_sovereign.w: Break the pods during her heal channel, and fight her in the open within 16 blocks so her bark lets blows through.
bestiary.nerocreatures.crystal_golem.abi: Neutral until struck: anger spreads to nearby golems. Slow, heavily armoured and almost immune to knockback.
bestiary.nerocreatures.crystal_golem.wea: You can always outrun it. A pickaxe kill yields extra Refined Crystal.
bestiary.nerocreatures.prism_stag.abilit: Sheds crystal antlers on a timer. At night a herd of three or more lights up and gives nearby players Regeneration.
bestiary.nerocreatures.prism_stag.weakne: Fights back only if hit. A lone stag gives no aura: the herd is the gift.
bestiary.nerocreatures.shardback.ability: A mirror fan reflects projectiles and blocks hits from the front. It paws and folds its plates before a charge.
bestiary.nerocreatures.shardback.weaknes: Hit it from behind, or while it charges and recovers. Arrows to the front come back at you.
bestiary.nerocreatures.facet_colossus.ab: Only one lit facet takes damage, and it rotates. Its beam refracts through arena crystals, and later phases add decoys.
bestiary.nerocreatures.facet_colossus.we: Strike the lit facet from the front, ignore the decoys, and hit the exposed core in the last phase.
bestiary.nerocreatures.asteroid_worm.abi: Burrows to approach, immune while underground, then surfaces with a telegraphed strike inside a 4-block ring.
bestiary.nerocreatures.asteroid_worm.wea: Move out of the ring during the telegraph, then hit it in the window after the strike before it dives again.
bestiary.nerocreatures.magnet_crab.abili: Wild, it steals dropped metal items into its shell. Tamed, it pulls nearby ground items to its owner's feet.
bestiary.nerocreatures.magnet_crab.weakn: A wild crab returns everything it stole when it dies, and taming one empties its shell at once.
bestiary.nerocreatures.gravity_leech.abi: Latches a tether that lightens your gravity, or briefly flips it, until the tether breaks.
bestiary.nerocreatures.gravity_leech.wea: Deal 6 damage to it, move 12 blocks away, or wait 5 seconds and the tether snaps. Kill it fast.
bestiary.nerocreatures.rogue_drone.abili: A machine that pounces after a short crouch and glides down at low gravity. Immune to poison, wither and hunger.
bestiary.nerocreatures.rogue_drone.weakn: Fragile: one or two good hits finish it. Watch for the crouch before the pounce.
bestiary.nerocreatures.rogue_android.abi: A four-charge shield absorbs every hit until it breaks, then the frame staggers for three seconds.
bestiary.nerocreatures.rogue_android.wea: Break the shield with four quick hits, then strike during the stagger for 1.5x damage.
bestiary.nerocreatures.terraforming_dron: Deployed from a Drone Shell, it tends an 8-block area around where it was put down with a growth tick every five seconds.
It never fights. It pauses while its owner is offline and only works where the world allows it.
bestiary.nerocreatures.space_pirate.abil: A raider whose fight depends on its kit; about 40% of a band carry crossbows and keep their distance.
bestiary.nerocreatures.space_pirate.weak: Rush the shooters first: each braces for half a second before firing. The melee half is weak alone.
bestiary.nerocreatures.cache_mimic.abili: Looks like a salvage crate until touched or hit, then splits open and bites. Settles back into a crate when left alone.
bestiary.nerocreatures.cache_mimic.weakn: A tamed Lumen Moth reveals a dormant mimic. Its loot is real, so the fight is worth it.
bestiary.nerocreatures.static_swarm.abil: A spark cloud that drains charge from energy items you carry within 4 blocks and shocks on contact.
bestiary.nerocreatures.static_swarm.weak: Below half health it can be bottled with a glass bottle into a Static Jar. Keep charged items away.
bestiary.nerocreatures.scrap_hulk.abilit: Assembles itself where three machines die close together, sheds parts as it takes damage, and sweeps a big telegraphed arm.
bestiary.nerocreatures.scrap_hulk.weakne: Each shed part lowers its armour: keep up the damage, and step out of the arm sweep when it winds up.
bestiary.nerocreatures.pirate_captain.ab: Jet-dashes at targets 5 to 16 blocks away after a nacelle flare and rallies nearby pirates.
bestiary.nerocreatures.pirate_captain.we: Stay close to deny the dash, and kill it before the crew it rallies. Its ledger maps a pirate stash.
bestiary.nerocreatures.void_crawler.abil: Blinks onto a target 5 to 20 blocks away once every five seconds, after a short crouch, then fights in melee.
bestiary.nerocreatures.void_crawler.weak: Keep your back to a wall and watch for the crouch. It is fragile once it is in melee.
bestiary.nerocreatures.plasma_slime.abil: An energy aura burns everything close every two seconds, and killing a large slime splits it into smaller ones.
bestiary.nerocreatures.plasma_slime.weak: Water and rain short its aura. Fight it in the open, or at range.
bestiary.nerocreatures.void_manta.abilit: A flying mount in low and zero gravity that glides elsewhere, with a short blink forward on a stamina cooldown.
bestiary.nerocreatures.void_manta.weakne: In normal gravity it can only glide, never climb. A blink stops short of solid blocks and costs stamina.
bestiary.nerocreatures.lumen_moth.also: Also in the overworld: dark forests at night.
bestiary.nerocreatures.lode_tortoise.als: Also in the overworld: deep caves.
bestiary.nerocreatures.static_swarm.also: Also in the overworld: during thunderstorms.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.stalker_hide: Insulation and soft armour in sibling mods.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.stalker_sine: Tames a Glacite Wisp; cabling elsewhere.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.lumen_dust.u: Crafts Glowstone Dust; Incubator and Lure Beacon recipes.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.slag_carapac: Chitin Bulwark and the Cinder Tyrant Sigil.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.heat_gland.u: Heat-gland Greaves and the Cinder Tyrant Sigil.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.rime_wool.us: Lurker Cloak and the Rime Matriarch Sigil.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.coolant_milk: Rime Flask and the Rime Matriarch Sigil.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.cryo_fang.us: Lurker Cloak and the Rime Matriarch Sigil.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.drifter_spor: Grows a crop twice; Bloom Sovereign Sigil.
Bloom Amulet and the Bloom Sovereign Sigil.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.raw_mossback: Food: cook it for Cooked Mossback.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.sovereign_se: Breaks down into four Bloom Hearts.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.refined_crys: Apex Altar; optics in sibling mods.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.prism_antler: Cuts into two Refined Crystal; Facet Colossus Sigil.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.mirror_scale: Mirror Shield and the Facet Colossus Sigil.
Heavy casing plate in sibling mods.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.ore_slurry.u: Ore processing: a random ore dust.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.contraband.u: A trade good: sells, never crafts.
bestiary.nerocreatures.drop.static_jar.u: Thrown: disables machines; or two Plasma Cells.
Tames a Xertz Forager; Drone Shell and Apex Altar.

quest.nerocreatures.menagerie.storm_stat: Scan a Static Swarm, then bottle a weakened one into a Static Jar. Swarms gather in thunderstorms.

quest.nerocreatures.menagerie.survey_mar: Scan the Dune Loper, the Strata Hound and the Dust Devil.
quest.nerocreatures.menagerie.survey_cin: Scan the Slag Beetle and the Magma Wader.
quest.nerocreatures.menagerie.survey_gla: Scan the Rime Yak and the Frost Lurker. Watch the snow underfoot.
quest.nerocreatures.menagerie.survey_gre: Scan the Spore Drifter, the Bloom Host, the Mossback and a Drift Leviathan.
quest.nerocreatures.menagerie.survey_nyx: Scan the Prism Stag and the Shardback.
quest.nerocreatures.menagerie.survey_ast: Scan the Magnet Crab and the Gravity Leech.
quest.nerocreatures.menagerie.survey_wre: Scan a Cache Mimic, a Scrap Hulk and a Pirate Captain.

gallery.nerocreatures.tour.plaza: Welcome to the Menagerie. Stand on a gold plate to see an ability.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.luna: Luna: Lunar Stalker, Lumen Moth, Echo Shrike, Lode Tortoise.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.mars: Mars: Dune Loper, Strata Hound, Dust Devil.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.cindara: Cindara: Slag Beetle and Magma Wader.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.glacira: Glacira: Glacite Wisp, Rime Yak, Frost Lurker.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.drops: Every drop in the mod. The wiki Drop Map says what each one makes.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.greenxertz: Greenxertz: Xertz Forager, Spore Drifter, Bloom Host, Mossback.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.leviathan: Drift Leviathan. Fly up and land on its back.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.nyxara: Nyxara: Crystal Golem, Prism Stag, Shardback.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.asteroid: Asteroid: Asteroid Worm, Magnet Crab, Gravity Leech.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.kiosk: Field Scanner. Gallery displays cannot be scanned; wild ones can.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.wrecks_machin: Wrecks: Rogue Drone, Rogue Android, Terraforming Drone, Scrap Hulk.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.gear: Creature gear, the saddle, the Capture Pod and the Field Scanner.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.wrecks_crews: Wrecks: Space Pirate, Pirate Captain, Cache Mimic, Static Swarm.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.hatchery: Eggs, plain and Radiant, with the blocks that hatch and raise them.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.cinder_tyrant: Cinder Tyrant, posed in each of its three phases.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.rime_matriarc: Rime Matriarch. The ice pillars are the only cover from her beam.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.bloom_soverei: Bloom Sovereign. She heals from her spore pods.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.facet_colossu: Facet Colossus. Only one facet is vulnerable at a time.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.deep_space: Deep space: Void Crawler, Plasma Slime, Void Manta.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.blocks: The habitat blocks. All of them are real and can be used.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.traits: The Trait Wall: all 13 Radiant morphs.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.paddock_loper: Mount paddock. Ride a Dune Loper; jump to leap.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.paddock_manta: Ride a Void Manta; jump to blink forward.
gallery.nerocreatures.tour.end: End of the tour. /nerocreatures gallery clear removes everything.
command.nerocreatures.gallery.busy: The gallery is still being built or cleared. Try again in a moment.
